title: Meera Fabrics Ltd.: choosing between equity and debt
body: Meera Fabrics Ltd. needs total funds of Rs. 50 lakh for a new unit. Its finance manager expects earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) of Rs. 6 lakh a year on these funds. Debt is available at 10% per annum and the tax rate is 30%. Equity shares have a face value of Rs. 10 each. Two options are being compared. Option I: raise the entire Rs. 50 lakh through 5,00,000 equity shares. Option II: raise Rs. 20 lakh through 10% debentures and Rs. 30 lakh through 3,00,000 equity shares. The directors want to know whether using debt will help or hurt the equity shareholders.
